top_choice_rationale: P002 (Crews, Deshaies, Ciulli; PROTAC-limited citation) is a molecularly defined, designable, catalytic event-driven principle, with ternary-complex structures, independent reproduction across many targets and E3 ligases, and wide use as a research tool and in clinical pipelines. Its weaknesses, no approved PROTAC and the separate cereblon glue lineage left out, are handled by the narrow citation. P001 (phase separation) follows as a mature physical-chemical principle with unsettled in vivo scope; nitrogenase and base editing rank next, and an award is preferred to none.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; postdoc mentors Stevens and Boey and my biosensor spin-out have no tie to any proposal, and my peptide self-assembly overlap with Emma Sparr is not a conflict
